hypothesis: Bounded unit inventories with explicit contribution assessments detect more contextual editorial defects than a whole-page list of selected findings, while preserving precision and technical meaning.
failure_policy: Stop on the first invalid response, tool event, failed call, or exhausted time budget. Retain every raw response and incomplete page. Never repair or retry within this run.
authentication: Existing Codex ChatGPT subscription. No API-key extraction, paid API fallback, or known monetary cost is claimed.

screen.unavailable_pages: Remain in all planned recall denominators and fail completeness. They are not observed semantic misses.
screen.partial_pages: Review and report their emissions separately; they cannot earn complete-page event credit. Also publish the accepted fraction of all valid-request emissions.
screen.suggestion_safety: Separate review dimension; never infer safety from a correct diagnosis. No automatic edits.

decision: Passing all complete exposed cohorts permits separate prospective confirmation, not product qualification. Failure rejects this candidate without lowering thresholds.
authorization: Offline preparation only until the user explicitly approves this new 88-request, four-hour maximum execution. The terminal preceding run provides no transferable call budget.
